title: A Codex with trix's hooks trusted says what it asks to run, and finishes
notes: Once Codex's /hooks trusted them, trix hears Codex's own lifecycle hooks: an exec_command approval names its command, and Stop ends the turn. Before the fake codex read trix's -c hooks, nothing exercised this path.

args.why: the approval hook makes it need you
a hooked Codex stays done once its turn ended
